3e817939a38a5a6f57e90100a7696faf7cb6e40c.text: A basket borrowed to point at others: that's 其, as in 其他 (the others)!

3ec00233cdb1cac2d7248ce5014eaff273f68d8c.text: Ding! The oven opens, and two sheep-shaped cookies sit side by side, looking exactly the same.

3f1ee81478af1c7d92336614d74cc112ea137055.text: Squeeze! You throw both arms around your little brother in a giant hug.

404cae809b30a5944ef180f03e4e90cc0036ce8c.text: 在现代简化字里，“來”写作“来”。

408d7a7f3f9219c75ecd9bce7cea76f1a5de9f55.text: In modern simplified writing, 歲 is written 岁.

40d2264c90a4d85d47b2e57af58cc21212c345af.text: 蓝蓝的天、绿绿的草、青青的山，都可以用“青”来形容！

410c7da249d41aa1a9f86a6d9eaac8d9ce319cd8.text: In modern simplified writing, 動 is written 动.

42df298a13ff03c35bb1b80737a94673eaff2071.text: 简化字“备”来自繁体字的另一种写法“俻”，去掉了左边的“亻”。

4307d13d4f122cdfa6e959f55315d6c2bdd3dd32.text: Later, 辵 (walking) was added, with 从 as the sound part, making 從. Simplified Chinese writes the old 从 again!

4358b524c6c5674c557c814074618ec37b93bca9.text: 王 plus one little dot: that's 玉, precious jade!

4359022fd160444e9e9ca71e47c11139c826ce76.text: And in simplified 马, the four galloping hooves are swept together into one fast horizontal stroke!

437d97e701ebb863f1df447566a0c335407b904f.text: 简化字“钟”把“童”换成了更简单的“中”，“中”和“钟”都读 zhōng。简化字“钟”还同时代替了另一个繁体字“鍾”。

439565c2111acd85447fde73576bda4a0c77784f.text: Cheep, cheep! Fluffy yellow chicks peck at corn while Mother Hen keeps watch.

43c79adc22078b08f8bb45b0866ad401a1bd3efb.text: 留在地上不走了，就是坐下的“坐”！

b6ebaf55bcf4c20a7c5ce765c61489a91a81cd2d.text: 在现代简化字里，“歲”写作“岁”。

b73c8d033f952d0100f6f0f89e64c0d613b4c027.text: 种下去，等一等，看它长高：“木”加上“尌”，就是大树的“树”！

b79c7f0c1955868d8f4ee23a34f3eb754e155bdb.text: In 鹿 today, the top roof and grid come from its head and antlers, and 比 at the bottom comes from its slender legs!

b84ea49eed116a135464039f0780effb7f6ef6ec.text: 直到今天，“月”字左边的一竖撇依然弯弯地向下伸展，就像月牙尖尖的角！

b86367afb77a0b1ca5975b447b0e212cd6299155.text: “和”把大家连在一起：你和我，和和气气，和平相处！

b86fbbab2d1371b42aadf9f0d2b5d40513890795.text: Put a roof over 豕 (pig) and you get 家 , home! Having a pig under your roof meant a well-fed family.

b8811a6d798d13de25bddb54296ed5be7bc5a614.text: Inch by inch, a little snail climbs the garden wall, carrying its house on its back.

b890acea15389ec49b26c50ccd2877d5a0f023c5.text: Simplified 车 comes from the quick cursive way of writing 車, just like 东 comes from 東.

b89d62dcedf5e491092dd7c6c3e67929275df3c9.text: 后来，“秋”变成了表示意思的“禾”，再加上一个简化了的表示读音的部分。所以今天我们看到的是“禾”和“火”肩并肩。

b8c42b75c9303446b695e5052fa77e16721bc534.text: Four lines looked too much like 二 and 三 when written in columns, so 四 was borrowed for its sound instead.

b8c4edfccb96c71c879bdc7a7aff8d709ea3fd57.text: Snap! You break a chocolate bar right down the middle and give half to your best friend.

b8e0960015b73716f4216cd1f1b6524c999674e6.text: 从“艸”加“犬”，到“竹”加“夭”，它一直都是笑哈哈的“笑”！

b9172cd16b7f8a140c3bbe36a5419dcae81580e1.text: 咕噜咕噜！晚饭还没做好，欧欧的肚子就叫了起来，响得连小猫都抬起了头。

b921a75b8f0d67491a2ff668a97dd88886ba526d.text: In modern simplified writing, 樓 is written 楼.

b932dcaa8308a7da4ff3e851115d6e3be794f10a.text: Black 黑 for the meaning, 占 for the sound: that's 点 (點), a dot!

b9626a813360078f2cd7e27a75cfa80b545bf2d7.text: “考”原来是拄着拐杖的老人，今天它是考试的“考”，祝你考出好成绩！

b9848c068bf023c9eedd5856324d515788abd0f6.text: In modern simplified writing, 貓 is written 猫.

b9919711a8c85479f99d052eb6f6560ffa823b29.text: When 漢 was simplified, its whole busy right side was replaced by a single 又.

b99c5fdfadb8db5d2478b3b3a71d274a0194edb2.text: Later the sound part 士 was added, and bit by bit it slid into the 土 you see in today's 在.

b99d324e308b6047326e08dba1cc540565a305f2.text: The person was later drawn as a woman, 女, the hands slowly moved upward, and the whole top part became 覀.

b9cdd8a0bcd645564b5a4277e68dcb58a597ee0b.text: 在现代简化字里，“兩”写作“两”。

b9d30029e2ae9d387cece05266d56e930ca2c401.text: In modern simplified writing, 爺 is written 爷.

b9d381c93958349fc9023d39fdeace69b71f337e.text: In modern simplified writing, 魚 is written 鱼.

b9e6c8a2c02fec9f6eb9a4e518687c103fb78930.text: Wings flapping again and again: that's 习 (習), to practice!

b9eb580cff6998804f1c58634c6efd98f5fc3dd5.text: 在现代简化字里，“黃”写作“黄”。

b9eca5e99d4ef80f193e2a57c1f11002116e92e7.text: Black ears, black patches, black as ink: that's 黑, black!

b9fa2374029f32545c62f32bcc667d277b0cb34b.text: 还在！连胡萝卜鼻子也还在。“还”读 hái 是“仍然、还有”，读 huán 就是“归还”。

ba248c54133bbcb9586140c6f8613ed3d6d89834.text: To stay dry in the storm, duck under an overhanging rock cliff! Right at the foot of the cliff sits a solid boulder.

ba40223f7b770c18952464412e725f632b5dbc79.text: 笃，笃，笃，是谁呀？小女孩往窗外一看，原来是一只啄木鸟在老树上敲个不停。

ba4995e69930f1073730d77127b2f25ab8dd7d72.text: 仔细看繁体字的左上角：那就是简化字“医”，由“匸”（收藏东西的框）和“矢”（箭）组成。

ba814b842b542b6b6599b35f0617d876982ce35b.text: In modern simplified writing, 飛 is written 飞.

ba8bc1b7e3f0dafb6776cb3f14f0f6375cf0560b.text: Wood 木 inside a house 广: that's 床, a bed! Now, lights out.

ba9b5d458080f2175accb32923be1130cfdc3bb8.text: One tree is 木, two trees make 林 (woods), and three trees stacked together make 森 (deep forest)!

bab03d2efad2f2fa9ecc165365c9e9ebe7928faa.text: There she is! After a whole year apart, Annie sees Grandma coming through the airport gate and runs to hug her.

baca07e333b679b4b02d8f2799120736fca4de25.text: In seal script, the hand 又 became 寸, which you can still see on the right of 對 and 对.

bae20b55370321c639ff958ec647995644dcc6b7.text: An empty dish, waiting to be filled with something tasty: that's 皿!

baff20cc479fab450dbb8255a4fc55b6b5cb0295.text: 喳喳，喳喳！梅阿姨闭上眼睛听了一会儿，马上就知道：“那是喜鹊！”

bb13c4c70aa04a00d1cd88fac861bdf1381ba324.text: 咩——咩！篱笆后面有一只温顺的小羊正望着你：头顶一对弯弯的羊角，下面是尖尖的鼻子和嘴。

bb3390f18991c3f78107aa0e2a6df204c08027ca.text: 后来又加上了表示读音的“士”，慢慢地，“士”变成了今天“在”字里的“土”。

bb3ae528fe20387c8d92c000cb7dda71aac0215d.text: Pointed roof on top, pillar in the middle, room below: that is 舍, a house to rest in!

bb3f495cc1d1de3a4dcf144e93bf1882596ff2b9.text: Open your mouth wide and add 阿: that's 啊, ah!

bb45863ffa00e31899f3863c711c4f65aaf9c2cc.text: Line up! Everyone takes turns on the swing: you go first, Leo goes second and Mia goes third.

bb52640808aead92022bf7837dcc1a9202191f6a.text: 手“扌”紧紧握住，“巴”来管读音，这就是把手的“把”！

bb599513648b81c80f1d2a5e8e9de5c88b20fafc.text: In modern simplified writing, 難 is written 难.

bb71524097298a21fdebfc67e9f9e43aeb33d75b.text: Crunch, crunch! You pour thin, golden potato chips into a bowl for movie night.

bbe3ede8ffab1c375b691cbcfa2a1abcc5997735.text: Who is keeping watch over the farmyard at dusk? A wise old grandfather: 叟!

bbeecb4b7f88a96017e0ff00b29dc0362bbbf2ce.text: 当当当！学校联欢会上，你戴上插满彩色羽毛的头冠，对着镜子转了一圈。

bc0563f56497c956d0f9f315eb71d5423ecae030.text: 在现代简化字里，“媽”写作“妈”。

bc0d4d831b70d6c97b7ff5a8a5a5ff0044c0bab7.text: “舟”是一条小木船，中间的横线是一块块木板。

bc13fc323ac7ff9681e299090db635cefe418c83.text: 在现代简化字里，“鵝”写作“鹅”。

bc15beda569d1ce5e641800f5bf80d74718f7102.text: 一个人，加上脚下的地面：这就是起立的“立”！

bc4939f2dbc22286e037afe9ea0cdf343c3c1c91.text: Ping, pong! The ball zips over the net, and Grandma hits it back with a sneaky spin.

bc541bd728723bc06c6809be8beb60ba20b42a1c.text: 泉眼“白”里涌出“水”：这就是泉水的“泉”！

bc5c9a997768bf1404ccd37db176c6f6ae42cd9f.text: 简体的“页”来自“頁”的草书写法。

bc7304616b73363369f54d1b223bd5345d38ace5.text: Simplified 儿 dropped the top part, 臼, and kept the bottom, which on its own is a standing person, a form of 人.

bc966c2eca949cfdc99110e02f7418785b3a08a0.text: Under the dry cliff, we light dry twigs into a crackling campfire: 火!

bcf0e374d5d83b015990624f0825aa0865e01619.text: High 卓 and wooden 木 together make 桌, a table for dinner, homework and secret forts!

bd0135d5fabf362324c6371ec7b85e8dc01cc54a.text: Tip-tap, tip-tap! Rain dances on the curved roof tiles of Grandpa's old house.

bd17e56e8f6f552b68124e6f1855a7c469b47398.text: In modern simplified writing, 買 is written 买.

be4d5794dd1913c8a997b5b331b404ec20e74ab6.text: 在现代简化字里，“畫”写作“画”。

be8c9c33a8f112be9c78868b9697043618f38861.text: Over time, each peak became a clean vertical stroke standing on one solid base.

be8fe6736f405dafa7c4fc94644c864d59b6c740.text: In modern simplified writing, 齒 is written 齿.

be90688204a87b74bc6e7ac40cacd754625c8026.text: In modern simplified writing, 樹 is written 树.

beb531e5e304a23ead1d6f735c39114b7dc6a5b4.text: Roof on top, 子 for the sound: that's 字, a written character, just like the ones you're reading now!

becb2e5976ccf390fb9980fa5d0e1a1106bc7f35.text: A foot stepping out of a cave: that's 出, to go out!

bedcbc56abb36f4e45fbba678a5d6677385739dd.text: 能用手摸的火，就是灰烬的“灰”！

bef4762729c0f998201f7f4ea9b5237849333d36.text: 而简化字直接回到了三千年前最初的模样：外框里面两个叉，就是渔网的“网”！

bf10a9a1b1fa8732e05a8ed818f5eba8f7eb0919.text: Fire you can touch with your hand: that's 灰, ash!

bf262153b5c3777358bb73d590ae83caa22b0e74.text: 小猫为什么躲到床底下？原来是外面在打雷！

bf4e5ea8a034f6507cd3a18b28abea76d364ac4d.text: 好冷啊！珂珂一跳下校车，呼出的气就变成了一团团小白雾。

bfa0a4bfbeaa846a1602379b118b10b61d2b3906.text: A woman 女 and a child 子 side by side: that's 好, good!

bfa34a4afd5770d9bc21196fda644ea7948681b8.text: 晃一晃……啵！布丁顺顺利利地从模子里滑了出来，一条裂缝都没有。

bfa7d5e82002bea04f286cd2b3c4f406e58117f6.text: 点点头，摇摇头，最上面的就是“头”！

bfaf4d10bc7c6670177d54b5d25796404d2530f4.text: 呜哇，呜哇！一辆红彤彤的消防车闪着灯，飞快地开过大街。

bfd3afc10d09fee427c45163ee93a9f2d6ef04b3.text: 打球、打鼓、打电话，手“扌”加上“丁”，就是“打”！

bfdb9e11210bfc11c3dc6d95ca33a4810353fc3a.text: 肚子咕咕叫，想吃东西了，这就是“饿”！快来吃点心吧！

bfe12e494dfe03b1ca082b84211f8612e4bc1891.text: In today’s 火, the sweeping center strokes are the main flame, and the two side ticks are dancing sparks!

c058dab54b4015bbf55f81ad5e955b802c7294a8.text: 轰隆隆——轰！雷声滚过操场，小朋友们尖叫着跑回了教室。

c0a5cbd4e9fd5587a227376f606d0a7f40b27de2.text: 痒痒的！有个软软的东西蹭着诺亚的脸，他还没睁开眼睛就觉得——是小猫来了！

c0d997dec445008a871f70c4e75ea061d738b437.text: A bird that keeps marching forward: that's 进 (進), to go forward or come in!

c0ef3ea3224054064360141069bb5c44c4e84c5a.text: 在路上用手捡到宝贝，这就是得到的“得”！

c1143e1473d25165139f3c450d73e7b855bbf80e.text: 从细细的小树枝，到长长的面条，“条”说的都是细长的东西！

c13c06cdcd6b29f2f4a6b1acb480b25c7f2d0641.text: 人的头上火光闪闪，这就是阳光的“光”！

c1409c75eeb3c53d36548e98231f200a08cb2d19.text: The ancient 马 is a horse standing up on its tail! Writers turned animals sideways to fit them into narrow columns. You can still see the mane and legs in 馬.

c1661760564e0ebebd0c8f265dd36ed9ca45ff03.text: 在现代简化字里，“現”写作“现”。

c1c28abf222ad0c6345f573924b6c6bfd80352eb.text: In seal script, those two lines were changed to 仌, ice, to make the cold even clearer.

c1c54a979bb9f82f954d435e1e9157e6a6d69d58.text: Spot it, know it: 认 (認) means to recognize, like all the characters you can read now!

c1cc2d6b3ff3fa129df0798ac1a5d16e37bcc155.text: 低头看！下过雨后，一条粉红色的蚯蚓从松软的泥地里探出了头。

c1d1e068fb69118cb7be278d3a02342b0bb1b110.text: In modern simplified writing, 會 is written 会.

c1f04d80c3637add0be8271a9877ec8bd47f20fb.text: 天为什么是蓝的？猫为什么会打呼噜？早饭还没吃完，波波已经问了爸爸十个问题！

c1f084ddbde27597bec4b8cbbf60c3bccca3339d.text: 中间弯弯曲曲的一道是湍急的主流，左右两边的小短线就是飞溅的水滴。

c23b4b434943e0f73d4e02d769889ecb23802fc9.text: In modern simplified writing, 興 is written 兴.

c23c95c3af1283d183a7f58748ea24d3cc355975.text: 到了毛笔字里，中间的水流拉直成挺拔的竖钩，两边的水花也连成了撇和捺。

c255e9e7d01e12695d02ee690b53f2cdf8f0bc68.text: 方方的井口，四边围着支架：这就是水井的“井”！

fb4244863b80f63a237fb7876db90829e776784d.text: Look down! After the rain, a pink earthworm pokes its head out of the soft brown ground.

fb665408c937fdf1cc9fa59f8e9de10c5f905957.text: 从前是用手往下按，今天是印章，也是印出来的图案——这就是“印”！

fbd72d36d954c7a9e861f0e046bf03f684f3eb41.text: A strong hand holding a tool: that is 父, as in 父亲, father!

fbe142b4c056ea18ca5cbec31a334d98837f7e75.text: Meow! plus 苗 makes 猫, the cat (written 貓 in traditional characters).

fbee38ddadf3ecbc951fab15a5453440360b759d.text: 一闪一闪亮晶晶！卢卡斯躺在后院的毯子上，想把天上的星星一颗一颗数清楚。

fc043ef4ffa0320b4c5abbdcbf0b83d793573b5c.text: Hair on top, an eye 目 below: that is 眉, as in 眉毛, eyebrow!

fc1c7212b233f5567932c65a900190f221574a4c.text: 你几岁啦？小男孩骄傲地伸出五根手指，又动了动第六根：“快六岁啦！”

fc1d49c6760884f1adc8c0cae864174e98b9382f.text: 往窗外看！有人正沿着街道散步，从侧面看过去，能看到一只摆动的手臂和一条迈开的腿。

fc2412cb8af8929357888b16f53ff2d8277d1d5e.text: 在现代简化字里，“絲”写作“丝”。

fc45b791e99db9f81827959b700b543977479541.text: Eyes closed for a good night's rest: 目 plus 垂 makes 睡, to sleep!

fc77c534db3f0b70bab94833bb83c25f98348308.text: Whoosh, splat! Tutu's snowball lands right on big brother's hat, and snow sprinkles everywhere.

fc9061a4c303f28912e20e4dbc855ffc8f948e2f.text: Slow and steady! In the story, the tortoise reaches the finish line first while the speedy hare snoozes under a tree.

fc95e81f0ad6f3347f9b7b646d588b1d24125075.text: 上面是太阳，下面是时辰——这就是清晨的“晨”！

fc9cf4027b53ab3fdff56475489a61c4ca14df30.text: Tiny 幺 helps you ask: that's 么 (麼), as in 什么, what?

fca49e05307d874c982ddbf0e489e3a369d1e2a7.text: Two brisk strokes , one hooked back, one sweeping blade , form 刀, knife!

fcc2453d3b7cdc24ebac5ffd04cf6ce3d2946f84.text: From the side of a shoe to a helping hand: that's 帮 (幫), to help!

fcc3d0374c808950791a2a9e176606ea221bfc38.text: 双脚飞快，耳边呼呼生风，这就是跑步的“跑”！

fcc6fb7e980d6cd4e58ef35fb333f5e12552e7ed.text: 一只手递过来，一只手接过去——这就是接受的“受”！

fcd465a3ea198e63e15317747e32bce5d884c8b0.text: 早上好！小木门打开了，家里的猫咪迈着小碎步走了出来。

fcdb517e026001bfac383a2fbeaccc50ddf03114.text: 后来，手“又”多了一横，变成了“寸”；贝壳先简化成“目”，又变成了“旦”。所以今天“得”的右边是“旦”加“寸”！

fce2db3b33c8daa1bd3994c084e7d170a2e2b987.text: Salty spray on her cheeks, Huahua stands at the front of the boat and sees nothing but blue water, all the way to the sky.

fce395a3fd94b669a7aa7495bb40715146e4a886.text: In today’s 羊, the two top ticks are still the sheep’s horns! And because sheep were prized, 羊 sits inside 美 (beautiful) and 善 (kind)!

fd0416a77fea12ad2b102993a48b9d4ebcec1da6.text: Grandpa fixes the chain on Mia's bike. 'Thank you, Grandpa!' she cheers, and gives him a giant hug.

fd226057f12e147621f6bba2e13945bb607b2fa9.text: Look at the building site! Diggers rumble while workers in yellow hard hats build a brand-new school.

fd23079da38ebdf2d60cf953d7235f8e848cb7f4.text: 晚期的金文又加上了“工”（工作）。这样写出来的字，原来表示“帮助”，这个意思现在写作“佐”。

fd23e5ac202ebc7b97d5a9e195c5636b8a946708.text: No wonder it's called 银河, the silver river! Metal plus 艮 makes 银 (銀), silver.

fd953ba00ae270551982a807af87e10924e0ee4f.text: One tree is 木. Put two trees together and you get 林, a little wood!

fdab1f202a9fbfd058abfb1844e4c5dcdcfe060a.text: Traditional 門 still shows both swinging doors, while simplified 门 traces the whole doorway in three quick strokes!

fdc15b662063c0b769bd837231446f279396ca03.text: 最早的“火”就像一团向上蹿的三簇火苗，左右两边还飘着火星。

fde8e9e19cd0641c7a3850cede88b6ab86d73e20.text: 哎呀！你往饼干罐里一看：只剩下一点儿碎屑和两块小饼干了。

fe0119425d7960ecfd71d25fa7001c5915c20c41.text: 伸向云朵的高楼：这就是高楼的“高”！

fe1e4cbd3f9e4fb666314d7da6d43ff4543b1b2d.text: Feet walk it, cars drive it, lights shine on it: that's 路, the road!

fe7eeb7bb62a5bd8753bbb8288764da971048d1b.text: In modern simplified writing, 頁 is written 页.

fea06bc76d0fe0ec762e84233e4793f837c4ac83.text: One person is 我, a whole group is 我们: that's 们 (們)!

fec64193db25aba226a437daf2bb7a4725da8be7.text: In modern simplified writing, 鵝 is written 鹅.

fed6e380bf68f29ee1f6a4a8242594acfe5c7750.text: 当当当！班上的礼物交换会上，桌子上堆满了大大小小的礼品盒。

fefcd1c108d0d4b049ff7bdb01fa34375f764fda.text: 一把告诉大家谁说了算的特别的斧头：这就是国王的“王”！

ff04ebaa35e93888c4b8772dc92b78030ce0d3d8.text: 星期一早晨！全校同学静静站好，看着旗子沿着旗杆慢慢往上升。

ff0a8d128a45f025283c46e31f5ee1f636cd1896.text: 嘘，这是秘密！小女孩床底下藏着一个小铁盒，里面有玻璃弹珠、压干的小花，还有一把小钥匙。

ff1649209d51321739bd4b7384c57c0c91d8b266.text: 美美举起望远镜，看见远远的地方有一排小小的蓝色山峰，那里天和地连在了一起。

ff31ad04cb0c67ac0497c866d1a32e1957a73335.text: 绕一圈，穿过去，拉一拉！你把鞋带系成了一个漂亮的兔耳朵蝴蝶结。

ff377be4df039b946153d2838ed18bfc849a6644.text: A grass part on top and 監 for the sound: 蓝 (藍) is blue, like the sky and blueberries!

ff497a7099552316bec23c9e1bcb4e3254cba7b3.text: 人在上面走，车在上面开，路灯照着它，这就是马路的“路”！

ff4ac8913419a16029104c588238f2206f37cca4.text: 和 links things together, as in 'you 和 me', and it also means getting along in peace.

ff4fd4d0853e7876a57fe587ccef5df712520e3e.text: 子 for the meaning, 亥 for the sound: that's 孩, as in 孩子, a child just like you!

ff58a0f751bed835cc41ad977ca091e0d58cf1ed.text: Built on, the mouth: that's 言, speech and words!

ff69052a488eb2a9074ee049e22593b18eb9ae62.text: 一大早，安娜就跑到窗前：她堆的雪人还站在院子里吗？

ff8520ce69e8d5472df48c2786b442c4d288549c.text: Tap, tap, BANG! Dad hammers the last nail into a brand-new birdhouse, just for you.

ff9d3fa2d5b07c0f785aa3d3acb09fcfa46da9c7.text: Waaah! Little Lulu's ice-cream cone tumbles onto the sidewalk, and she bursts into tears.

ffbfc1bbd41cb019f4c593179a7aaf24f7a0fecf.text: 劈啪，劈啪……篝火慢慢烧完了，石头围成的圈里只剩下软软的灰。

fff3c05612ceed26b6065cbd69f2e9b5fc0bcccd.text: Why is the sky blue, and why do cats purr? Before breakfast is over, Bobo has asked Dad ten questions!
